response.sql: WITH combined_data AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), status_totals AS (SELECT orderflow, SUM(cnt) as total_for_status FROM combined_data GROUP BY orderflow), with_shares AS (SELECT cd.ordervault, cd.orderflow, cd.cnt, (cd.cnt * 1.0) / st.total_for_status as share FROM combined_data cd JOIN status_totals st ON cd.orderflow = st.orderflow), status_avg_shares AS (SELECT orderflow, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares GROUP BY orderflow), final_data AS (SELECT ws.ordervault, ws.orderflow, ws.cnt, ws.share, ws.share - sas.avg_share as share_diff FROM with_shares ws JOIN status_avg_shares sas ON ws.orderflow = sas.orderflow WHERE ws.share > sas.avg_share) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, share_diff FROM final_data ORDER BY share_diff DESC LIMIT 10;
